rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows a real aggregate cost defect. The March 31, 2026 schedule reports total amortized cost of 1,410,219,978 at table 7 row 32, while the conservation artifact reports only 1,237,484,289 across 85 extracted cost rows, a shortfall of 172,735,689. The same source row separately reports fair value of 1,239,482,127, confirming that 1,410,219,978 is the cost anchor. The schedule structure does not tie the residual to a single position or subtotal, so the defect is not localized and escalation is appropriate.
